source: Registers are not an addressable cache that threads browse collectively. They belong to the execution state of individual threads. One thread cannot simply load another thread’s register value through an ordinary memory address. Communication between threads therefore uses other mechanisms such as shared memory, warp-level operations, or architecture-specific collective instructions.
zh: 寄存器不是线程共同浏览的可寻址缓存。它们属于各个线程的执行状态。一个线程不能简单地通过普通内存地址加载另一个线程的寄存器值。因此，线程之间的通信使用其他机制，例如共享内存、warp 级操作或特定于体系结构的集体指令。
